deploy_command: Workers Builds deploys main; .github/workflows/post-deploy.yml (read-only) waits until /version.json serves the pushed commit, then runs scripts/sgps-pdv-run.mjs

signed_in.reason: Public organisational site: no account or signed-in surface.

rollback.command: wrangler rollback --name web, run by the Owner or an agent with Workers access when the post-deploy run fails
rollback.deviation: PDV-R7 open: AGENTS.md keeps GitHub Actions free of Cloudflare secrets and deploy commands, so the read-only job cannot roll back. Owner decision pending (2026-11-26).

schedule.where: post-deploy.yml on every push to main and daily
